name: @lorewardens/docs-extension
description: Lorewardens Google Docs extension (MV3, loadable unpacked): findings as native Docs comments plus a sidebar, via the loopback bridge

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/background dist/sidepanel dist/options && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/sidepanel/sidepanel.html dist/sidepanel/sidepanel.html && cp src/options/options.html dist/options/options.html && cp -r dist/src/. dist/
